caption:
For the thing you lost and still think about

Every calamity was written before it happened, so that you do not grieve over what passed you by, nor become proud of what you were given. Rest your heart in that tonight.

Surah Al-Hadid 57:22-23

Save this for the day you keep replaying what you missed.

#qadr #letgo #surahhadid #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
alt_text: No calamity befalls the earth or yourselves but it is already written in a Record before We bring it into existence. That is indeed easy for Allah – so that you may not grieve over what you have missed, nor exult over what He has given you, for Allah does not love anyone who is conceited and boastful – (Surah Al-Hadid 57:22-23)
theme: loss and decree / not grieving over what passed
